CustomObject.description: Sync-direction gateway for the iPad app. One record per Salesforce object family the app can sync — controls whether it syncs at all, in which direction (Salesforce to iPad, iPad to Salesforce, or Bi-Directional), and which side wins if the same record changed on both sides. Editable here in Setup with no deployment — the app always reads current values from these records rather than assuming any policy in code.
CustomObject.label: Sync Object Config
